annotations.title: Humanize AI-Generated Text into a more natural, human-sounding variant while preserving the requested tone and rewrite mode.

description: Transforms AI-generated text into a more natural, human-sounding variant while preserving the requested tone and rewrite mode. Input must be at least 300 characters and must not exceed 2,000 words.

apiKey.description: The API key to use for the GPT Human API. Deprecated: Use the Authorization header Bearer instead.

mode.description: Optional rewrite mode. Defaults to `Balanced` when omitted.

text.description: The text to humanize. Must be at least 250 characters and must not exceed 2500 words.

tone.description: Optional tone for the rewritten text. Defaults to `College` when omitted.

name: humanize_text
title: Humanize Text
